figures.label: S2
figures.caption: Figure S2. Rietveld plots for neutron diffraction patterns for pristine (top) NCM111 and (bottom) NCM811 powder samples. The data were recorded at λ = 1.1545 Å using the HRPT diffractometer of the Swiss Spallation Neutron Source (SINQ), Paul Scherrer Institute (PSI), Villigen, Switzerland. For Rietveld refinement, FullProf software was used. The (red) observed, (black) calculated, and (blue) difference neutron diffraction profiles are shown. The green ticks indicate the position of the Bragg peaks. As evident, the experimental data are well described, with χ2 = 1.328 and 1.843 for NCM111 and NCM811, respectively. The degree of cationic disorder for the Li and Ni was found to be 4.3% and 6.8% for NCM111 and NCM811, respectively.
